summary: This chunk adds new output artifacts for the iteration-2 eval-1-pasted-traceback debug-loop test. It includes transcript notes describing a 12-step debug session (reproduce a KeyError from a UTF-8 BOM header, add a failing regression test, fix by switching to utf-8-sig encoding, confirm 3 tests pass). It also adds grading.json, metrics.json, and timing.json for both with_skill (5/5 expectations passed) and without_skill (4/5 passed, missing the pre-edit debug brief) runs, plus a new gitlink entry for without_skill's outputs/project pointing to a dirty submodule commit.

claims.text: The with_skill transcript shows a debug brief step is not explicitly listed, but the with_skill grading.json states a Debug Brief was emitted before any edit
The with_skill run reproduces the crash via `python3 report.py data/sales-2026-08.csv` producing a KeyError with exit 1, and pytest shows 2 passed before the fix
The root cause is identified as a UTF-8 BOM in the header, confirmed by printing repr of the first parsed key showing '﻿region'
A regression test test_utf8_bom_header_is_parsed was added and confirmed failing before the fix, then passing after changing encoding to utf-8-sig
The with_skill run passed all 5 grading expectations (debug brief, repro, BOM identification, root-cause fix, regression test)
The without_skill run failed the 'emits a debug brief before editing any source file' expectation, with evidence 'No brief'
The without_skill run otherwise passed repro, BOM identification, root-cause fix, and regression test expectations, for 4/5 total (pass_rate 0.8)
The with_skill run used 16 total tool calls (8 Bash, 3 Read, 2 Edit, 3 Write) across 12 steps, 37860 tokens, 86.7 seconds
The without_skill run used 12 total tool calls (5 Bash, 2 Read, 2 Edit, 3 Write) across 10 steps
A new gitlink (mode 160000) was added for without_skill/outputs/project pointing to commit f4b8e7098eb0ad942754faa1eb45f26a7f7247a2, marked dirty

risks.note: Identical timing.json content (37860 tokens, 86706ms) is added at two different paths (run-1/timing.json and top-level timing.json), duplicating the same data.

The project output is committed as a gitlink to a dirty submodule commit rather than as a normal tracked directory, which means the actual file contents of that run's output are not captured in this diff.

The with_skill grading.json asserts a debug brief was emitted before any edit, but the corresponding transcript-notes.md in this chunk lists no explicit debug-brief step, so the claim rests on the grading file alone.

least_confident: Whether the with_skill run actually emitted a debug brief is unclear, since the transcript-notes.md step list in this chunk does not show a distinct brief step even though grading.json asserts one passed.
